name: Upload N months worth of Jira Issues from all projects to Snowflake using Replicate Feature
description:
1. Sync First 100 Issues from Jira (all projects) into Snowflake
  - If Table is not present
    - Workato will create the table
    - Create the corresponding columns for the table
  - Else if table is present
    - Workato will check to see if all corresponding columns are present, and maintain them if necessary

2. If there are more issues, sync them over to Snowflake

block.name: declare_variable
block.title: Create variable FetchIssuesFrom
block.comment: The No of Months Issues should fetch from?
